title: Damage / impact record
description: One row per ward per event per indicator, describing what was damaged or affected. See METHODOLOGY.md sections 5-7.

event_id.description: Matches the id in that event's event.json, e.g. '2026-08-koshi-floods'.

adm4_pcode.description: Ward P-code, joining to admin_boundary.adm4_pcode. A baseline row must exist for the same ward and the matching baseline indicator (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

indicator.description: Controlled vocabulary of damage indicators, deliberately mirroring the baseline indicators they are compared against.

report_date.description: Date the underlying figure was collected/reported, not the date this row was entered.

verification_level.description: See CONTRIBUTING.md. 'unverified' rows must not be included in published totals/rates.

confidence_note.description: Optional free-text caveat, e.g. 'District total only, not yet disaggregated to ward.'
